\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{semilogxaxis}[scale only axis,width=56mm,height=35mm,
    xmin=1,xmax=64,ymin=0,ymax=7,enlargelimits=false,
    axis lines=box,xtick=\empty,ytick=\empty]
    \addplot[only marks,blue,mark=*,error bars/.cd,x dir=both,x explicit]
        coordinates {(4,1) +- (4,0) (8,3) +- (12,0) (16,5) +- (8,0)};
    \addplot[only marks,red,mark=*,error bars/.cd,x dir=both,x explicit relative]
        coordinates {(4,2) +- (1,0) (8,4) +- (1.5,0) (16,6) +- (0.5,0)};
\end{semilogxaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
